2124931569668493678.en_summary: Posts With the AI trade back, bottlenecks should rally harder than megas. You have... Power, like $NUAI and $VST. Photonics, like $AAOI and $AXTI. Neoclouds, like $NBIS and $IREN. Plus a few more... and the most supply-constrained sectors will capture the most inflows. 2124930624024899670.en_summary: BOS Account: With $QQQ Calls! In Power Plays Options, we have been waiting for fat pitches. The action has been difficult with no day-to-day follow-through. And on Friday, we got our opportunity by getting long $QQQ November 27 $635 calls. I told subscribers this at 12 pm ET: “The market has deteriorated to the point where we are extremely oversold short-term. The Oscillator is -65 so we could see a short-term bounce.” Nvidia $NVDA had dropped by nearly half in 2 months. Anthropic's $ANT IPO fever didn't last. The VIX was at a 7-month high. The prevailing wisdom was that AI was on the verge of a slowdown. The negativity was so loud that conditions were ripe for a short-term bounce. When everybody hates the market, the market tends to bounce, at least for a few days.
